sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: On Android TV, shows a one-time message that future Android TV patches come from the tv-morphe-patches source. It does nothing on a phone.
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Lets the patched app start by skipping Google's Pairip license check.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Removes the ads in on-demand videos and the limits on skipping live TV breaks.
